notes_for_editor: The NHLR entry is the only source with tower-specific facts. Its visit date (7/77/22) is not a valid date, so only the year is used and the event is undated within 2022. The Forest Lookouts Wren page shows its title and a site-wide index of lookouts; the readable text has no Wren details. Wikipedia adds only the NHLR listing. The Dispatch article is Oktibbeha County coverage used for state context only. No staffing, fire or access information was found. The 100 ft height is converted to 30.5 m. The brief's county (Monroe) and agency match the NHLR entry.
